sections.changelog: v1.2.99: Implemented Media Studio UI improvements: removed Asset Manager title, eliminated hardcoded Testimonials/Team collections, unlocked dynamic collection creation with Phosphor duotone icon picker, added transparent checkerboard grid backgrounds, resolved image details file-name styling and preview switching latency, added sorting and type filters, fixed grid item overlap, and replaced all native confirm dialogs with custom ConfirmModals in Media & Content Studios.
